reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
ORDER BY multi_unit_lines DESC, store_code
LIMIT 3
alternatives: SELECT store_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 END) AS multi_unit_lines FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units >= 2) AS multi_unit_lines FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code ORDER BY multi_unit_lines DESC, store_code ASC LIMIT 3

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units >= 2) AS multi_unit_lines FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code ORDER BY multi_unit_lines DESC, store_code ASC LIMIT 3
other_way.tradeoff: Reads closer to plain English, but FILTER is not available in every SQL dialect.
